meta.title: Evaluators can only be changed during evaluation time
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

plan.title: UI-TECH-015 Evaluator Change Blocked Outside Evaluation

steps.note: Open a suitable existing published event for testing the technical-stage evaluator controls.
Navigate to the published RFP stage, which is the subject of the test.

args.goal: on the published RFP stage outside evaluation time, try to change the evaluator; verify the evaluator-change control is unavailable or the attempt is refused with the app's message, reload the page, and prove the evaluator remains unchanged

steps.note: Perform the unavailable/refused evaluator-change attempt and verify there is no silent change after reload.
Confirm the final screen remains the technical-stage page after the reload and verification.
